quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release: revenue $1.9m, an increase of 412% from Q2 2025 (statement of operations: $1,931,381 versus $376,984; six months $2,225,396 versus $702,077); Adjusted EBITDA $0.6m versus $(1.7m); net loss $(430.4m), including non-cash items totaling $423.8m, primarily a $400.4m fair value loss on convertible notes. CEO James Manning: 'Revenue is expected to ramp materially from the third quarter of 2026 through 2027'; the company is on track to bring contracted capacity online in accordance with its deployment schedule.

Q2 2026 balance sheet (deployment build-out): customer deposits of $143,879,911 at June 30, 2026 (none at December 31, 2025) and equipment, software and lease prepayments of $302,647,678; advance payments for property and equipment were $310,665,524 in the six months ended June 30, 2026.
